items.subject: Small-input direct-output reduction and launch crossover
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, explore a generic size-based single-CTA reduction that writes directly to out for small inputs, eliminating intermediate partials and the final device copy where beneficial. Measure crossover thresholds rather than hardcoding test sizes. Explicitly compare against the baseline n=1 device-to-device copy path, which launches no kernel, and retain whichever path measures better. Keep a correct fallback for larger inputs and preserve correctness, bounded reads, exact int32 results, ABI, and default-stream behavior for every legal size. Compare all checks and repeated timings.
